requirements.title: ENDFILE explicitly writes an endfile record
requirements.definition: An endfile record is written explicitly by an ENDFILE statement.

pending.explicit-endfile-statement-writes-endfil: Write a known sequential file, execute ENDFILE, then READ with IOSTAT initialized to a nonzero sentinel until the named endfile condition is observed; do not assert a numeric status value.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.

requirements.title: Explicit ENDFILE requires sequential access connection
requirements.definition: For explicit endfile record writing, the file shall be connected for sequential access.

pending.explicit-endfile-requires-sequential-acc: Positive plan uses a sequential connection. A source-control negative differs only by direct or stream connection, but no diagnostic facet is filed unless later ENDFILE execution rules make a portable rejection observable.

requirements.title: Certain positioning or close/open actions implicitly write an endfile record after output
requirements.definition: An endfile record is written implicitly to a sequential file when the most recent data transfer for the file is output, no intervening file-positioning statement for the file has executed, and either REWIND or BACKSPACE references the connected unit or the unit is closed explicitly, by normal termination, or by another OPEN for the same unit.

pending.implicit-endfile-after-output-before-rew: Write a known sequential record, execute REWIND or BACKSPACE without intervening positioning, then read records until named endfile; anti-vacuity requires the known data record to be read first.
pending.implicit-endfile-on-close-after-output: Write and close a sequential file, reopen for reading, and observe known record then named endfile condition; do not compare IOMSG or numeric status.
pending.implicit-endfile-on-open-same-unit-after: After OPEN semantics are registered, open another file on the same unit following output and verify the first file retains the known record followed by endfile.

requirements.title: An endfile record occurs only as the last record of a file
requirements.definition: An endfile record shall occur only as the last record of a file.

pending.endfile-record-last-record-only: Positive plan writes data followed by ENDFILE and observes named endfile after the last data record. A negative plan attempting data after an endfile must be attributed to later positioning/data-transfer rules, not this catalogue alone.

requirements.title: Endfile records have no length property
requirements.definition: An endfile record does not have a length property.

pending.endfile-record-no-length-property: No portable oracle exists for measuring an absent length property; future tests must observe endfile position/status behavior rather than comparing a length.
